kind: supplement: canonical texture-sampled controls for the ordinary holdout scenes
purpose: The holdout run captured the texture-sampled arm only where a level had to be measured, so four light ordinary holdout scenes and one dark one had no texture-route control in the reading. These are that control, read from the canonical capture tree. Nothing was captured and no holdout cell was drawn again; the canonical tree is read-only here.

textureRouteAgreement.what: Every calibration scene's canonical texture-sampled PNG compared by digest against the candidate phase's own sampled arm. The profile document's hash matching proves only that the same document was applied and cannot see a code change; this is the empirical check that the canonical tree's texture route draws what the candidate's does.

method.instrument: The G0 region reader, imported: declared rounded-box masks from scripts/declared-geometry.ts, mean Euclidean OKLab distance over the declared visible footprint.
method.directDeltaEAgainstControl: Mean OKLab distance between the candidate's page-route capture and this canonical texture-route control, over the same declared footprint as the native ΔE. Computed only where the arm's PNG on disk still digests to the sha256 the holdout reading recorded.
method.diagnosticBudget: The three distances side by side — control-to-native, arm-to-native and arm-to-control — plus arm minus control. A diagnostic, not an attribution: it bounds how much of the page route's distance to Apple is not shared with the texture route.
method.missing: The three dark controls the canonical tree does not hold are null, not substituted.
